## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-07-02: S-1/A files the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.1.
- 2021-07-16: IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement dated July 16, 2021 between Bridge Investment Group Holdings Inc., Bridge Investment Group Holdings LLC, and the Members.
- 2021-07-20: 8-K reports IPO close and files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.1.

#### Post-IPO restatement

- 2022-01-01: Amended and Restated TRA effective January 1, 2022; administrative cleanup tied to the close of the IPO Unit Redemption and Recapitalization. 85% rate and tax-attribute scope unchanged. Filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the Q1 2022 10-Q.

#### Apollo merger and assumption

- 2025-02-23: Second Amended and Restated TRA executed in connection with the Apollo merger announcement; Apollo Global Management, Inc. joins as a co-party. TRA Members agree to forego the Change of Control acceleration the merger would otherwise have triggered; post-close realized tax benefit calculation references Apollo's consolidated group.
- 2025-02-24: 8-K announces the merger and files the executed Second A&R TRA as Exhibit 10.1.
- 2025-09-02: Apollo merger closes; Bridge Corp becomes a wholly owned subsidiary of Apollo; TRA continues under Apollo's consolidated tax position.
- 2025-09-12: Bridge files Form 15-12G deregistering; the Second A&R TRA continues under Apollo's CIK.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from Bridge Investment Group Holdings Inc.'s July 16, 2021 Up-C IPO, with 85% of cash tax savings shared back to the Continuing Equity Owners of Bridge Investment Group Holdings LLC on Section 754 basis step-ups from exchanges of Class A Common Units, Pre-IPO Tax Assets, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. The January 1, 2022 Amended and Restated TRA was administrative cleanup following the IPO close. At the February 2025 Apollo merger announcement, the parties executed a Second Amended and Restated TRA effective at the September 2, 2025 merger close: instead of triggering an Early Termination Payment under the Change of Control acceleration, Apollo assumed the TRA as a co-party and the realized-tax-benefit calculation now references Apollo's consolidated group. Bridge deregistered on September 12, 2025; the TRA continues at Apollo, and a parallel copy of the Second A&R is saved under Apollo's CIK. See `contract_log.md` for the four-document lineage and the assumption-not-termination analysis.
